_comment: Canonical cross-language runtime values. The JS relay/PWA read these from public/runtime-constants.js and public/wire-protocol.js; the Swift client hand-mirrors them in PhoneWireProtocol.swift. Both sides assert against this file so a one-sided edit fails a build instead of silently changing one client's behaviour. Durations are milliseconds; the Swift mirror stores some as seconds and its test converts.
